target.title: fix(edit): keep mismatch hint truncation unicode-safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When an edit replacement cannot find its exact `oldText`, the tool appends a bounded `Current file contents:` hint. Raw UTF-16 slicing could cut an astral character in half at the 800-code-unit boundary, producing a malformed diagnostic.

## Why This Change Was Made

The mismatch formatter now uses the repository's existing `truncateUtf16Safe` helper. This keeps the original 800 UTF-16-unit output bound while omitting a boundary-straddling surrogate pair whole; it avoids both malformed Unicode and the earlier draft's accidental expansion to as many as 1,600 UTF-16 units.

The regression test exercises the real `createEditTool(...).execute(...)` mismatch path with 799 ASCII code units followed by an emoji.

## User Impact

Long edit-mismatch diagnostics remain bounded and never contain a dangling surrogate or replacement character. Edit matching, writes, approvals, protocol, gateway, and UI behavior are unchanged.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/sessions/tools/edit.test.ts` — 20/20 passed.
- Live edit-tool invocation against a temporary file through `createEditTool(...).execute(...)`:

```text
{"mismatchHeader":true,"utf16UnitsBeforeMarker":799,"emojiOmittedWhole":true,"danglingSurrogate":false}
```

- Fresh pre-commit and branch auto-review: no findings (confidence 0.99 and 0.98).
- Exact-head hosted CI is required before merge.

## Proof Scope

No external channel, Gateway, or UI proof is relevant because this patch changes only local diagnostic truncation. The live invocation covers the production edit-tool path rather than a standalone helper.
